04  —  The GST rebate

First-time buyer? The GST could be on us.

Thanks to the new federal First-Time Home Buyers' GST Rebate, eligible first-time buyers pay $0 federal GST on a brand-new Martell home.

On a new Riverview Heights home from $380,000, that's up to about $19,000 back.

100% of the 5% federal GST on new homes up to $1M (partial to $1.5M, max $50,000).

Your builder can credit it right at closing — off your price, not a wait for a refund.

General information, not tax advice. Eligibility and amount are confirmed with your accountant. See canada.ca.
